handoff.next_immediate: Optional, not yet requested: (1) `fix scripts` - delete the stray scripts/theme-toggle at the package root (stow links it as ~/theme-toggle) and add --no-folding to the `scripts` stow in both bootstrap scripts; (2) delete the EXITED stale Zellij sessions lumera-arc and dotfiles; (3) duplicate-compinit cleanup in zsh/.zshrc.
handoff.watch_out: Bootstrap's plain `stow ... scripts` can fold a missing ~/.local/bin (or ~/.local) into a repo symlink, after which the claude/codex/grok installers would write into the repo - on a new machine run mkdir -p ~/.local/bin first or stow with --no-folding. Codex/Grok status line keys need python3 >= 3.11 (tomllib). On Mjolnir ~/.config/zellij is a directory symlink into the checkout, so git pull applies config.kdl changes live.

repo_state.summary: Agent CLI status lines are portable (8c0480a): the agent-cli stow package holds ~/.claude/statusline.sh and ~/.grok/statusline.sh, and bin/setup-agent-statusline.sh links them with stow --no-folding and upserts only Claude .statusLine, Grok [ui.status_line] and Codex [tui] status_line/status_line_use_colors (validated JSON/TOML, idempotent; --check is called by check-health.sh). Both bootstrap scripts run it and install jq (plus python on macOS). Live on Sleipnir; accepted 2026-09-26.
zellij config.kdl sets web_sharing "off" (e21524b): sessions are shared through the web server only when they opt in; web server service files unchanged.
theme-toggle also themes Claude Code, Codex and Grok and has an `auto` mode (d773ca9); BRIDGE toolkit upgraded to v3.0.2 (6c7fae5).

scripts/.local/bin/update-agents.sh is stowed to ~/.local/bin/update-agents.sh. It checks Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and Gemini (agy) and runs each installer only when a newer release is available, then prints what changed and the current version of each tool.

Zellij web access live on Mjolnir and Sleipnir at https://<host>.z42.work:8082 (c1b8942, bf56bac, 213a0b2): shared config.kdl, per-host --ip/--port/--cert/--key flags in the systemd unit / LaunchAgent (reference copies in launchd/), web client themed Catppuccin Macchiato. Runbook lives outside the repo (MySecondBrain inbox).

bin/new-zellij-project-layout.sh now generates single-pane claude, codex, and grok tabs; a code tab running nvim; and two-pane tools and shell tabs. README documents the layout. Existing local layouts require --force regeneration, and an existing named Zellij session must be deleted before the new layout structure appears.

New scripts stow package installs ~/.local/bin/theme-toggle (Catppuccin latte<->macchiato toggle for Alacritty + Zellij via live config reload, explicit flavours + status supported); both bootstrap scripts stow it; zellij config normalized to a single theme line; zshrc gained grok CLI PATH/completions block.
bin/bootstrap-macos.sh supports --minimal for shell/Zellij essentials; bin/check-health.sh supports matching --minimal verification; README documents both commands.

recent_decisions: 2026-09-26: Zellij web_sharing defaults to "off" (operator decision), superseding the "on" part of the 2026-08-26 web-access decision
2026-09-26: Agent CLI status lines ship as an agent-cli stow package (scripts only, --no-folding) plus bin/setup-agent-statusline.sh for per-key config upserts; agent configs stay unmanaged
2026-08-26: Zellij web access uses one shared config.kdl with host-specific settings as CLI flags in each host's service file; secrets stay in ~/.config/lego/env
2026-07-21: Project layout scaffolds use six role-specific tabs: claude, codex, grok, code, tools, and shell; agent tabs stay as plain shells rather than auto-launching CLIs
2026-07-04: Theme switching is a manual toggle command, not OS-appearance- or schedule-driven (user explicitly rejected following desktop mode)
2026-07-04: User-facing commands live in the scripts stow package (scripts/.local/bin -> ~/.local/bin); repo tooling stays in bin/
2026-07-04: Font-size changes use Alacritty's built-in Cmd+= / Cmd+- / Cmd+0 bindings; no custom tooling (Zellij inherits terminal font)
